detail.longDescription: A human approval gate only holds if the operation approved is the operation executed. Loopjacking (arXiv, Sep 17): the reviewer approves A, mutable pending state swaps in B before release. Reproduced in 7 Agno AgentOS releases up to 3.0.9 and 12 in-memory LangGraph Agent Server versions up to 0.14.0. OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22 held: serialized continuation binds each call and rejects a mutated B. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2609.21081 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # LangGraph # Programming
